records.label: spacr.qt.mask_engine#2
records.source: THREE INVERSIONS LIVE HERE AND THEY DO DIFFERENT THINGS. :func:`invert_intensity` is the photographic complement of an IMAGE -- ``dtype_max - value``, what a viewer's Invert does, exactly reversible on every integer dtype -- and it is what the Make Masks screen's "Invert image" draws with. :func:`invert_for_detection` reflects an image about its OWN range instead, and is what the screen's "Invert for detection" hands the detectors; its docstring has the measurement that says why a detector cannot use the complement, and it is NOT a duplicate to be merged away. :func:`invert_mask` flips a LABEL image's foreground and background; on an ordinary field that gives one object covering the frame, which is why it was reported as doing nothing.
records.context: Three inversions live here and they do different things. :func:`invert_intensity` is the photographic complement of an IMAGE -- ``dtype_max - value``, what a viewer's Invert does, exactly reversible on every integer dtype -- and it is what the Make Masks screen's "Invert image" draws with. :func:`invert_for_detection` reflects an image about its OWN range instead, and is what the screen's "Invert for detection" hands the detectors; its docstring has the measurement that says why a detector cannot use the complement, and it is NOT a duplicate to be merged away. :func:`invert_mask` flips a LABEL image's foreground and background; on an ordinary microscope field of view that gives one object covering the frame, which is why it was reported as doing nothing.
records.translation: 这里有三种反转，它们的作用各不相同。:func:`invert_intensity` 是图像的摄影学补色——``dtype_max - value``，即查看器的 Invert 所做的操作，在所有整数 dtype 上都可以精确还原——Make Masks 界面的 "Invert image" 就是用它绘制的。:func:`invert_for_detection` 则是把图像关于其自身的取值范围进行镜像，界面的 "Invert for detection" 交给检测器的就是它；其文档字符串中给出了说明为什么检测器不能使用补色的测量结果，而且它并不是一个应当合并掉的重复函数。:func:`invert_mask` 翻转标签图像的前景和背景；在普通视野上，这会得到一个覆盖整个画面的对象，这就是它曾被报告为不起任何作用的原因。

records.label: spacr.run_journal#8
records.source: Beside the runs, the journal keeps two records for blinded work. :func:`start_blinding` writes a blinding key (coded names and a shuffled order) to ``~/.spacr/blinding`` and :func:`unblind` logs who opened it and when. :func:`lock_analysis` freezes an analysis plan, hashed and timestamped, in ``~/.spacr/analysis_locks`` (settings of one or more pipelines, Gate Editor gating strategies, models and files); every later run of a locked pipeline on its ``src`` is checked against it by :func:`check_analysis_lock`, every model the run records is checked as it is recorded, and the verdict is written into that run's ``manifest.json`` under ``analysis_lock``, with any difference also listed in ``provenance_warnings``.
records.context: Beside the runs, the journal keeps two records for blinded work. :func:`start_blinding` writes a blinding structured-data name (coded names and a shuffled order) to ``~/.spacr/blinding`` and :func:`unblind` logs who opened it and when. :func:`lock_analysis` freezes an analysis plan, hashed and timestamped, in ``~/.spacr/analysis_locks`` (settings of one or more workflows, Data-selection boundary Editor data-selection filtering strategies, models and files); every later run of a locked workflow on its ``src`` is checked against it by :func:`check_analysis_lock`, every model the processing-session records is checked as it is recorded, and the verdict is written into that processing session's ``manifest.json`` under ``analysis_lock``, with any difference also listed in ``provenance_warnings``.
records.translation: 除处理记录外，日志还为盲法工作保存两类记录。:func:`start_blinding` 将盲法编码表（编码名称和打乱的顺序）写入 ``~/.spacr/blinding``，:func:`unblind` 记录由谁在何时打开了它。:func:`lock_analysis` 把分析计划冻结在 ``~/.spacr/analysis_locks`` 中（一个或多个流程的设置、Gate Editor 的门控策略、模型和文件），并附上哈希和时间戳；之后对已锁定流程在其 ``src`` 上的每次处理都由 :func:`check_analysis_lock` 与之核对，该次处理记录的每个模型在记录时即被核对，结论写入该次处理的 ``manifest.json`` 中的 ``analysis_lock`` 下，任何差异也会列在 ``provenance_warnings`` 中。

records.label: spacr.suggest#4
records.source: 1. A SUGGESTION IS NEVER CONFUSABLE WITH A DECISION. Suggestions are stored as their own values -- a suggested 1 becomes 11 -- so nothing that reads the annotation column can mistake one for a human's answer, and a run that goes wrong is undone by deleting a value rather than by remembering which rows were touched. 2. A SUGGESTION NEVER OVERWRITES AN ANNOTATION. Writes carry ``IS NULL``. Not when the model is confident, not on a re-run. A human's labels are the ground truth the model was fitted on; losing one silently would cost hours and would not be noticed until a run came out wrong. 3. NO CONFIDENCE FLOOR, SO THE ORDER CARRIES THE DOUBT. Every unannotated crop gets a suggestion, sorted most-confident first, and the reviewer stops where they stop agreeing. A threshold would make that decision for them, with a number nobody chose. 4. A JUDGEMENT IS RECORDED, NOT INFERRED. Confirming a suggestion turns it into an ordinary label and rejecting one clears it -- and both are written down beside the column, in ``<column>_verdict``, as the class that was confirmed (``+c``) or rejected (``-c``). A rejection is information the next round can train on -- "not class 1" is an example of class 2 in a two-class column -- where a NULL would have been silence. The verdict column is added the first time a source is opened, so tables made before it existed gain it without a migration step.
